description: This file implements a delegate for TensorFlow Lite that utilizes Metal API for GPU acceleration on Apple devices. It includes classes for managing GPU tasks, synchronization, and buffer management, and provides functions for delegate creation, buffer binding, and command buffer setup. The code facilitates GPU-accelerated model inference with control over precision and synchronization strategies.

classes.name: GpuAlarmClock
classes.description: Manages a multi-thread safe alarm clock that keeps the GPU awake by running lightweight compute tasks to prevent GPU sleeping, especially for aggressive wait strategies.

classes.name: Delegate
classes.description: Main class implementing the Metal-based delegate for TensorFlow Lite, handling buffer management, model building, invocation, synchronization, and external buffer binding.

methods.name: Delegate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the delegate with optional configuration options, setting up Metal device, command queue, and possibly an alarm clock for aggressive GPU wake-up.

methods.name: BindBufferToTensor
methods.description: Binds a Metal buffer to a tensor in the interpreter, managing quantization mappings and updating tensor buffers.

methods.name: SetCommandBuffer
methods.description: Sets an external Metal command buffer for subsequent invocation, allowing external control over GPU commands.

methods.name: GetRequiredTemporaries
methods.description: Provides the list of temporary tensors needed for the delegate's operations, especially for quantization/dequantization processes.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the delegate by converting the execution plan into a GPU model, managing tensors, buffers, and model configurations, and setting up the execution environment.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the delegated computation on GPU, managing data transfer, command encoding, synchronization, and optional quantization steps, with support for different wait strategies.
